Lucas no-carry criterion gives maximal surviving t: p odd j=(p^a-1)/2,k=(p^b-1)/2, while p=2 maximal t=2^(a-1)-1. Top odd-degree A^j B^k becomes u^(p^a-1)v^(p^b-1), equal to full group sum, with coefficient (-1)^(b(p-1)/2); rank-one kernel count then exact. final_claim: For prime p and integers a>=b>=1, the nearest-neighbor toroidal Laplacian on (Z/p^a)x(Z/p^b) over F_p has exact nilpotence index 2^(a-1) when p=2 and (p^a+p^b)/2 when p is odd. For odd p its final nonzero iterate is (-1)^(b(p-1)/2) times the full group-sum convolution, rank one, and exactly (p-1)p^(p^(a+b)-1) inputs remain nonzero at that time.
